subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation
messages:
From: Julia Nguyen <julia.nguyen@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - report + audit period

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off our standard vendor security intake for the upcoming platform rollout and need your SOC 2 Type II materials to close out the procurement review. Specifically: 

- A copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report (or an executed bridge letter if the report is not yet available).
- Confirmation of the audit period covered (start/end dates) and whether any subsequent change controls occurred during that period.
- A minimal evidence list or intake CSV that maps the control families to where we can find supporting artifacts (logs, configs, policy docs).

Our deadline to complete the security review is 2026-09-10. If possible, can you share the report (or bridge letter) and the minimal evidence inventory by 2026-09-03? If you prefer, we can sign an NDA to enable sharing.

Thanks,
Julia Nguyen\Vendor Security Lead\Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Julia Nguyen <julia.nguyen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - report + audit period

Hi Julia — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can support this. Quick summary of options and what I can share now: 

1) Full SOC 2 Type II report: we can share the 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 Type II PDF under our standard NDA/channel. I attached a redacted summary (redwood-soc2-typeii-summary.pdf) to this reply to give you the key findings and the audit window.

2) Bridge letter: if you need an explicit bridge while an in-flight report is prepared, we can provide a signed bridge letter template that confirms continued coverage and notes any material changes. I attached our bridge letter template (redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-template.docx).

3) Minimal evidence inventory: I can provide a CSV that maps control families (CC1–CC7 / common criteria) to artifact types and owners. See minimal-evidence-inventory.csv (attached) for the starters — we'll add links after we finalize transfer channel.

Notes: the last completed audit period covered is 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30. There have been routine maintenance changes during that window; nothing the auditor classified as a material control exception. If you need confirmation of specific control activities (e.g., privileged access review cadence or backup test dates) call that out and I will escalate.

Next steps I propose:
- If you can sign the attached NDA or send a DocuSign link, we'll upload the full report to a secure Drive link.
- If you prefer bridge letter first, I can route for signature and provide the signed PDF within 48 hours.
- I will loop in Soojin (security) and Sean (compliance) for the evidence inventory and any technical notes.

Would you like the bridge letter first or the full report under NDA?

Best,
Marissa Cole\Enterprise Sales\Redwood Inference\(415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-soc2-typeii-summary.pdf, redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-template.docx, minimal-evidence-inventory.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Julia Nguyen <julia.nguyen@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II - report + audit period (Acme Retail)

Team — forwarding Acme's request (below). They want either the Type II report or a signed bridge letter plus a minimal evidence map by 2026-09-03. My ask: can you review the attached bridge-letter template and confirm we can sign as-is or whether legal/compliance wants edits? Also: if we proceed with bridge letter, can Soojin drop an updated minimal-evidence-inventory.csv with direct links to artifact locations (Drive/Jira/Confluence) and a short owner column?

Specific questions: 
- Any items we need to redact before sharing the full Type II PDF?
- Do we need to include a cover note about the 2026 maintenance window (two routine platform patch windows in Apr/May) to avoid back-and-forth?
- Sean — if we sign a bridge letter, confirm if the bridge should reference the completed audit period only (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) or call out an in-flight assessment (none currently scheduled).

I copied Julia so they have visibility but please reply-all with a concise checklist I can send them.

Thanks — Marissa\n

> Julia Nguyen

From: Julia Nguyen <julia.nguyen@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - report + audit period

Hi Marissa / Soojin / Sean,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments — the summary is helpful. Acme is happy to accept a signed bridge letter while you finalize any outstanding report deliverables. A couple of quick asks so we can close the security review by 2026-09-10: 

- Please provide the signed bridge letter PDF (we can accept the template you attached once signed).
- Minimal evidence inventory with owner and link columns (Drive / Confluence / Jira) — ideally the CSV you referenced.
- Confirmation that the audit period covered by the last report is 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 and that there were no auditor-reported exceptions during that window.

Also: we will execute an NDA prior to the report upload. I'll send a DocuSign link for the redwood NDA by end of day. Once executed, please place the signed bridge letter and the minimal evidence CSV in the secure Drive link.

If you can provide the signed bridge letter and inventory by 2026-09-05, we will mark the security review complete and proceed to procurement approval.

Appreciate the help — Julia\Vendor Security Lead\Acme Retail
